actual_scope: Determine the exact scalar minimal polynomial of the full one-slot doubled centre Gram A_1 from PR4958, with a characteristic-zero annihilator and a matching lower certificate. Canonical claim: Discussion 5142.
scope_change_reason: Handoff-first selection follows the explicit remaining annihilator question of PR4958 and PR5120. This is a finite exact decoder-algebra theorem, not a proof-assistant campaign or another small Krylov lower-bound increment.
bottleneck_link: Scoped side result: closes the one-slot scalar-polynomial decoder degree question and gives its exact inverse-polynomial degree when the affine operator is invertible. It does not price native access or general ADD circuits, and it does not admit a supplier or change kappa.
stop_rule: Within two hours derive a complete exact annihilator from all 512 Bell blocks; stop without a lower-bound-only PR if this fails. Reserve the remaining donor budget for exact replay, source/export checks and overlap refresh. Higher tensor-width upper bounds and physical construction are excluded.
evidence: Normal and optimized registered replays PASS_EXACT_ONE_SLOT_GRAM degree=881 in 115.49 and 113.48 seconds; identical deterministic output is retained in RECEIPT.json (not trusted by the verifier). PROOF.md covers all 512 Bell labels, 20 nonzero central sectors and all 512 zero-block matrices. Exact integer upper annihilation, 21 nonzero modular Hankel determinants, matching global LCM and ten controls pass in a clean Python 3.12 environment without FLINT. No proof-kernel or independent human acceptance is claimed.
